method.value: Noise map from MAD, two-stage strict mask (3.5σ in 3 channels, dilated to 2σ in 2 channels) plus 500 pc mask → broad mask; moment-0 and moment-1 velocity maps

evidence.quote: We first identify all regions with $T_{\rm B}>3.5\sigma$ in three consecutive channels. These regions are then dilated in three dimensional space to all connected regions that show $T_{\rm B}>2\sigma$ in two consecutive channels.

evidence.quote: the velocity field at high resolution differs from the velocity field measured at 500 pc resolution by more than $30~\mathrm{km~s^{-1}}$.

analysis_steps.goal: Fit global disk orientation with MCMC

method.value: Fit circular-rotation model V_los = V_sys + V_rot cos(theta) sin i to all lines of sight; radial V_rot(c1) via linear least squares in beam-wide annuli nested in MCMC over phi, i, V_sys, sigma_0^2; cos(theta_PA) weighting

evidence.quote: We sample a four-dimensional parameter space defined by $\phi$, $i$, $V_{{\rm sys}}$ and excess variance $\sigma^2_{0}$, leaving the center position $(X_{{\rm cen}},Y_{{\rm cen}})$ fixed for this analysis.
In total, the emcee sampler sampler is run for 1000 steps with 50 walkers.

key_parameters.value: Walkers initialized uniformly within 50 deg width centered on photometric phi and i

evidence.quote: we initialize the walkers for $\phi$ and $i$ in the emcee sampler in a uniform distribution with a conservative width of 50 degrees

assumptions.value: Thin circular disk, constant phi and i with radius; q_min=0.25 for photometric inclination

evidence.quote: which we fix to a value of $0.25$ (cite: vdW2014)

fitting.value: emcee; flat priors on phi, i, V_sys; sigma_0^2 ~ InvGamma(N, 2.5); Gaussian log-likelihood with weights

evidence.quote: We assume an inverse-Gamma distribution for the excess variance with a characteristic scale $2.5~\mathrm{km^2~s^{-2}}$

evidence.quote: Our assessment of the quality of these results is motivated by extensive testing of the method on mock galaxy velocity fields.

method.value: Four radial bins, three jackknife realizations removing two bins, mean absolute difference times 1.25 as Gaussian 1σ

evidence.quote: Finally, we convert the values of mean absolute difference to a representative Gaussian $1\sigma$ error by applying a multiplication with a factor of $1.25$.
The jackknife uncertainties overall yield median uncertainties of 1.3 and 5.6 degrees on $\phi_\mathrm{kin}$ and $i_\mathrm{kin}$, respectively.

method.value: Flag unreliable i_kin via Tully-Fisher velocity consistency, |i_kin-i_phot|≳30 deg, and strong large bars (eps>0.4, R_bar/R_CO,max≳0.45); use i_phot for those

evidence.quote: Galaxies with large strong bars (as quantified by $\epsilon>0.4$ and $R_{{\rm bar}} / R_{{\rm CO,max}}\gtrsim 0.45$) are also flagged as unreliable

method.value: Least-squares fit with fixed orientation in 150 pc wide radial bins; 100 Monte Carlo realizations perturbing phi, i, V_sys by jackknife errors and center by 1 arcsec; drop bins with <10% detections or mean angle from major axis >55 deg

evidence.quote: we adopt $\delta=55$ degrees and a 10% threshold for our sample.
The error on rotation velocity at a given radial bin is then computed based on the 16th and 84th percentile of the 100 realizations.
